components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next safe action; follows the selected theme accent and reaches 48px on coarse pointers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 45%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; min-width: 48px; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary and local actions without competing with the route's primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); border-color: var(--primary); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 45%, transparent); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; min-width: 48px; } }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: Dark inset field for search, auth, settings, and Salon editors.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-customer-search">Customer search</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-customer-search" placeholder="Name, phone, or preference">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 12px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 16px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-field:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-field { min-height: 32px; font-size: 14px; } }

components.name: Healthy Status Chip
components.description: A semantic status that carries icon and words before colour.
components.html: Confirmed
components.css: .ds-status-good { height: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 8px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 10%, transparent); color: var(--success); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-good svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-status-good:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Surface
components.description: A bounded surface used only when a section boundary carries operational meaning.
components.css: .ds-ops-surface { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.18); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-ops-surface header { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-ops-surface > div { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; } .ds-ops-surface strong { font-size: 18px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ops-surface small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Daybook Now Row
components.description: The signature chronological seam joining time, current state, customer, and status.
components.html:
15:30
Riya ShahCut & finish with Tara
NOW2:59 pm
components.css: .ds-daybook-row { position: relative; min-height: 88px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px minmax(0,1fr); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-daybook-row > time { padding: 20px 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted-foreground); text-align: right; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-daybook-detail { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 16px; } .ds-daybook-detail strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-daybook-detail span { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; } .ds-now-line { position: absolute; left: 46px; right: 0; top: 70px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 12px auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--primary); } .ds-now-line b { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-now-line i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-soft); } .ds-now-line span { font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-now-line::after { content: ''; height: 1px; background: var(--primary); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-daybook-row { grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0,1fr); } .ds-now-line { left: 76px; } }

components.name: Mobile Navigation Item
components.description: Thumb-reachable labeled navigation with active tint and a constrained unread count.
components.html: 3Messages
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { position: relative; min-height: 56px; min-width: 72px; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 11px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-mobile-nav > span { position: relative; min-width: 48px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mobile-nav svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-mobile-nav b { position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -2px; min-width: 16px; min-height: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 4px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mobile-nav[aria-current=page] { color: var(--primary); } .ds-mobile-nav[aria-current=page] > span { background: var(--primary-soft-2); } .ds-mobile-nav:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-mobile-nav:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Conversation List Row
components.description: WhatsApp-familiar message list row; the chat palette never follows the selected Salu accent.
components.css: .ds-conversation-row { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; padding: 12px; background: var(--chat-panel); color: var(--chat-ink); text-align: left; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-conversation-row:hover, .ds-conversation-row[aria-current=true] { background: var(--chat-surface); } .ds-conversation-row:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--chat-accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-conversation-avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #2a3942; font-size: 14px; } .ds-conversation-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-conversation-copy > span { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-conversation-copy strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-conversation-copy time { color: var(--chat-muted); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-conversation-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: var(--chat-muted); font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-conversation-row > b { min-width: 20px; height: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 5px; background: var(--chat-accent); color: var(--chat-panel); font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Salu is a live shift book, not an analytics dashboard. Urgent replies, the current appointment, and expiring deposits lead; history follows. Cool near-black planes, fine ruled seams, compact sans type, tabular numerals, and a visible now line provide the identity established by direction seed `deebff86` and the shipped Now Line composition.

The interface is phone-first and expands without changing its reading order. Expression stays restrained: the selected accent locates interaction and current state, while familiar WhatsApp material is confined to Messages.
keyCharacteristics: One chronological operational flow with a live now seam.
Five selectable accents over dark, quiet working surfaces.
Status words and icons before colour.
Tonal layering, precise borders, and few meaningful containers.
Compact metadata that remains subordinate to actions and customer content.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Outside Messages, the selected theme colour is the only decorative accent. Status colours communicate state; chart colours identify data; neither becomes decoration.

rules.name: The WhatsApp Boundary Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green and the dedicated chat canvas, panels, bubbles, and ink belong only to Messages. Theme Emerald is deliberately distinct and does not license WhatsApp green elsewhere.

rules.name: The Compact-Type Rule
rules.body: The 9–11px steps are reserved for short operational metadata with nearby context, never instructions, form values, errors, or body copy.

rules.name: The Operational Numeral Rule
rules.body: Times, counts, money, and countdowns use tabular numerals so live changes do not shift alignment.

rules.name: The Stable Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts may add columns, never reorder urgent work behind history or detach a row action from its customer.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Rows share a ruled surface and separate with rhythm or lines. A card exists only when its boundary carries meaning.

rules.name: The One Page Heading Rule
rules.body: Every route or route-level error owns exactly one `h1`; the shared header title is contextual text, not a competing heading.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Loading, empty, partial failure, permission, expired session, save, and send states use explicit text plus icons where useful. Failed or absent data never renders as a healthy zero.

dos: Do put urgent action and current-day state before historical analysis.
Do preserve all five accents and test focus, text, and semantic status against each.
Do keep touch targets at least 48px on coarse pointers and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do retain drafts and explain recovery after save, send, session, or connection failures.
Do keep the same task order from 320px phones through 1440px desktop.
donts: Don't rebuild the product as a generic grid of metric cards.
Don't use WhatsApp green, chat bubbles, or the doodle canvas outside Messages.
Don't use gradients, glowing chrome, salon stock imagery, or decorative scissors motifs.
Don't hide permissions by removing controls without explanation.
Don't show missing or failed data as zero, empty, saved, sent, or all-clear.
